scope: Immediate predecessor before table containing-block repair, full physician attestation hash, and mobile environment spacing
method: SIMULATED expert review using exact-commit source, 287 local tests, 19 focused UI tests, a 17 by 11 local browser workflow matrix, a 16 by 11 local browser state matrix, a 17 by 4 mobile context matrix, semantic scans, direct horizontal scroll gestures, and local visual inspection. No authenticated staging, real identity, assistive technology, cross-browser, or human validation was used.

required_categories.basis: Operational hierarchy, status wrapping, badges, panels, and controls were coherent, while root table overflow and wide layouts remained.
Exact authoring, comparison, release, logout, and session-state paths were clear, while several governed workflows remained absent or read only.
Recovery copy and stable structure helped, but every role still received seventeen top-level destinations and dense expert terminology.
Named navigation, explicit selection, and retained mobile context were strong; role-based starts, deep links, and guided queues remained absent.

Cursor draining removed silent 200-row truncation, but the browser could still aggregate up to 50000 rows and lacked server-side search, cancellation, saved views, deep links, bulk work, and shortcuts.
Full source, privacy, revision, and audit hashes were visible without title reliance; the duplicate Physician attestation hash remained abbreviated.
Source joins, exact item comparison, and exact release selection were strong, while protected comparison and claim-to-anchor navigation remained incomplete.
Fail-closed access, readiness, exact If-Match, correct-option rules, same-item comparison, exact release selection, and session distinctions reduced consequential errors.
Focused expired, revoked, outage, signed-out, and deterministic recovery states were strong; protected compare-and-reapply and canonical staging return remained open.
Controls, panels, states, focus, pagination, and safety language were coherent, with remaining inconsistency in role text and duplicate hash presentation.
Pagination, mobile context, badges, controls, and state views passed, but four table workflows still created twenty page-root overflow failures.
Semantics, focus, contrast, targets, pagination, and mobile context were strong locally; WCAG reflow failed and assistive-technology evidence was absent.
Consequential work bound exact immutable identity and session failures remained explicit and fail closed; authenticated staging and real role evidence remained external.
The restrained operational design was polished on phone and desktop apart from root table overflow, tight mobile environment spacing, and wide reading measures.

aggregate_basis: Equal-weight mean of the fourteen required categories, rounded to two decimals.
